challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.selfDescription: Switch back to your own profile to take part.
challenges.loadError: Could not load Challenges. Check your connection and try again.
challenges.emptyDescription: Turn everyday steps into friendly competition. Start with a day or make it a week.
challenges.coverageHint: Missing data counts as zero in the score, but does not mean no steps were taken. Available data may still change.
challenges.consentHint: Each person chooses whether to join. Only aggregates for the chosen Challenge metric are shared.
challenges.noConnections: No eligible connections. Manage Family & Friends in web Settings, or create a Challenge and invite them later.
challenges.capacity: This Challenge has reached its participant limit.
challenges.actionError: Could not save this change. Check your connection; membership or permissions may have changed. Try again after refreshing.
challenges.cancelConfirm: Cancel for everyone? Step sharing stops and this cannot be undone.
challenges.leaveConfirm: Leave this Challenge? Your steps will be removed from its results, and you cannot rejoin.
challenges.rulesFixed: Dates, timezone and scoring stay the same.
challenges.name: Challenge name
challenges.invitationDescription: A friendly steps Challenge is waiting. Review the rules before sharing your step totals.
challenges.resultsUnavailable: Scores are unavailable. Open this Challenge to retry.
challenges.subtitle: Small steps. Shared momentum.
challenges.moreHistory: Load older Challenges to see more active competitions and history.
challenges.acceptPrivacy: Accept to share your daily step totals for the whole Challenge date range, including earlier days. Other health data stays private.
challenges.invitationClosed: This Challenge is closed. You can dismiss the invitation.
challenges.noScoresBeforeAccept: Scores are visible after you accept.
challenges.reconciles: Results can change when step data arrives late or is corrected.
challenges.createDescription: Choose your days, invite your people, and keep moving together.
challenges.canonicalHint: Your existing daily step totals count. There is nothing extra to track.
challenges.dateHint: Both dates count. Choose between 1 and 366 days.
challenges.timezoneHint: This sets when the Challenge starts and ends. Steps keep their existing daily date buckets.
challenges.createConsent: You join automatically. Invited people must accept before their steps are shared. Dates and rules cannot be changed after creation.
challenges.invalidForm: Enter a name of 1–100 characters and a valid 1–366 day range starting today or within the next year.
challenges.coverage_other: {{present}} of {{eligible}} elapsed days have step data
challenges.coverage_one: {{present}} of {{eligible}} elapsed day has step data
challenges.dashboardHint: Move together. Make every step count.
challenges.hubDescription: A little friendly competition. A little more movement.
challenges.creatorJoined: You join automatically. Your friends receive invitations.
challenges.validationError: Add a name, a valid timezone and a date range of 1–366 days starting today or within the next year.
challenges.workoutHint: Recorded qualifying workout duration counts. Calories and workout count do not decide the winner.
challenges.workoutCoverage: {{present}} of {{eligible}} elapsed days have recorded workouts
challenges.workoutCoverageHint: No workout recorded does not mean all devices have synced. Ambiguous unfinished workouts are excluded; available data may still change.
challenges.workoutInvite: A Workout Time Challenge is waiting. Review the rules before sharing aggregate workout time.
challenges.workoutConsent: You join automatically. Invited people must accept before aggregate workout time is shared. Dates and rules cannot be changed after creation.
challenges.workoutTimezoneHint: This sets when the Challenge starts and ends. Workouts keep their existing daily date buckets.
challenges.workoutLeaveConfirm: Leave this Challenge? Your workout time will be removed from its results, and you cannot rejoin.
challenges.workoutCancelConfirm: Cancel for everyone? Workout time sharing stops and this cannot be undone.
challenges.workoutCancelledHint: Cancelled. Workout time sharing has stopped.
challenges.workoutReconciles: Results can change when workouts arrive late, are edited or deleted.
challenges.workoutAcceptHint: Accept to share daily aggregate workout time and session counts for the whole Challenge date range, including earlier days. Workout details and other health data stay private.
challenges.rematchReview: Review your rematch. Everyone you invite will choose whether to join again.
challenges.rematchOmitted: Some previous participants are no longer eligible and have not been selected.

notifications.invitationBody: You have a new invitation. Open to review and choose whether to join.
notifications.startBody: Your Challenge starts today. Keep moving together.
notifications.endingSoonBody: One day left. Open to see the latest progress.
notifications.endedBody: Challenge finished — open to see the latest result.
notifications.leadBody: Your position at the lead changed. Open to see the refreshed result.
notifications.remoteHint: Invitations can arrive while the app is closed when your server supports push. Delivery uses Expo, Apple and Google without sharing scores or health data. Other alerts use data synced on this phone.
notifications.hint: Alerts use results refreshed on this phone. Lead changes are checked when the app refreshes.

surfaces.empty: No Challenges. Create one in the app.
surfaces.notSynced: Open the app to sync Challenges.
surfaces.lobby: Waiting for players · Review in the app

challenges.aggregateConsent: Only daily aggregates for the chosen metric and your chosen target are shared after acceptance. Other health data stays private.
challenges.cancelledAggregate: Cancelled. Challenge data sharing has stopped.
challenges.aggregateReconciles: Results can change when canonical data arrives late, is corrected or deleted. Locked targets stay unchanged.
challenges.metricHint: Only the chosen daily aggregate is shared after acceptance. Personal targets are confirmed in the lobby and lock when everyone is Ready.
challenges.readyTiming: Starts when all invitations are resolved and everyone is Ready. With next full day off, the entire current day counts, including activity before activation.
challenges.waitingDates: Dates set when everyone is Ready
challenges.metricCoverageHint: Missing data scores zero. It does not mean all devices have synced. Results can change when data is corrected.
challenges.progressRules: Each day earns actual ÷ your target × 100 points, without a cap. Points accumulate; equal points tie.
challenges.goalDayRules: Each day at or above your target counts once. Equal goal-day totals tie.
challenges.lobbyRules: At least two people must join. Pending invitations block the start. Choose your own target, save it and press Ready. Targets lock when everyone is Ready.
challenges.nextDayHint: When everyone is Ready, targets lock and scoring starts on the next full day in the Challenge timezone.
challenges.immediateHint: When everyone is Ready, scoring starts immediately. The entire current Challenge-local day counts, including earlier activity.
challenges.goalSuggested: Suggested from your personal goal. You can choose a different target for this Challenge.
challenges.invalidTarget: Enter a positive target with at most six decimal places in the canonical unit.

ux.chooseTargetReady: Choose your target and get ready
ux.nextDay: Starts the day after everyone is ready.
ux.todayIncluded: Starts when everyone is ready. That day's earlier activity counts too.
ux.waitingRule: Starts after invitations are resolved and everyone who joins is ready.
ux.personalSuggestion: From your personal goal. Edit for this Challenge.
ux.reconfirm: Your saved target changed. Review it before confirming again.
ux.readyFailed: Target saved. Ready was not confirmed. Review the saved target and try again.
ux.joinThenTarget: After joining, choose your target and confirm Ready.
ux.targetsLocked: Targets are locked. Everything is ready.
ux.emptyHistory: Completed and cancelled Challenges will appear here.
ux.dashboardSetting: Show your current Challenge or next invitation
ux.cancelConfirm: Cancel for everyone? Challenge sharing stops and this cannot be undone.
ux.leaveConfirm: Leave this Challenge? Your results will be removed and you cannot rejoin.
ux.removeFromLobby: Remove this participant from the lobby.
ux.discardBody: Your changes have not been saved.
ux.waitForSave: Wait for the save to finish before leaving.
ux.unavailable: This Challenge is no longer available.
ux.unsupported: Update the app or server to use this Challenge.

modes.pointsHint: 100% earns 100 points. Going beyond earns more.
modes.daysHint: Count days you reach your target. They need not be consecutive.

goals.moveExplanation: You can import today’s Apple Fitness Move goal. Apple Health may ask for Activity Summary access. Your saved goal changes only after you choose Use and Save.
goals.moveUnavailable: Apple Move goal unavailable. You can enter your own active-calorie goal.
goals.activityExplanation: Goals use your normal dated goal timeline. They can suggest a Challenge target; changing a personal goal never changes a locked Challenge target.
goals.invalid: Use positive numbers or leave a goal blank.
goals.saveError: Could not save goals. Try again.
goals.waitForSave: Wait for the save to finish.
